sheets_documents: Addendum 3 (new panels note), E-2.1 (Dillons, KC, EPB schedules), K2.0 item 68

question: Addendum 3 notes three new panels 'to manage lighting and sound' and the Dillons panel to be removed carries 7 TV-outlet and 3 POS circuit lines, but no sound / AV system, TV / video distribution, data / telecom cabling, network rack or security device is drawn on any sheet: please state whether any low-voltage system other than the POS J-boxes (K2.0 item 68) is in the general contractor's bid and issue its drawings.

subject: ADA lift pit and '(N) structural beam below'
question: A-6.21 KN12 refers to a '(N) structural beam below' the ADA lift 'see S-2.10' that is not on S-2.10, and the lift pit slab thickness, reinforcing and concrete strength are not detailed: please issue the pit and beam details.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Other required scope: lines S-09 (pit base and beam), D-28 (pit cut 21.1 SF) and the special inspection trigger (G-15, concrete above 2,500 psi) cannot be priced.

subject: Stair 1 landing supports
question: S-2.10 places the two 'HSS4x4x1/4' labels on diagonal lines at the landing corners while 5/S-3.20 draws vertical posts, and the landing is dimensioned 4'-4" x 3'-9": please confirm whether the landing is supported on vertical posts or kicker braces and the landing size.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Other required scope: lines S-03 (HSS8x4 landing beams), S-04 (landing framing), S-05 (posts 15.9 LF) and S-06 (base plates, 8 epoxy rods) depend on the support type.

sheets_documents: Exit-stair set: A-6.10, A-6.11, S-2.10, S-3.10, ENERCALC
subject: Exit-stair landing size, pan fill and guard
question: The exit-stair landing is dimensioned 5'-0" x 4'-0" on A-6.10 while the ENERCALC landing beam spans 6.0 ft and a 6'-3" dimension sits outside the landing, the pan-fill concrete depth and strength are not stated (special inspection applies above 2,500 psi), and the A-6.11 sections show a picket guard where the plan shows walls on both sides: please confirm the landing size, the fill depth and strength, and whether a guard is required.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Stairs & railing: lines X-03 (pan fill, no depth), X-04 / X-05 (landing beams and framing), X-12 (guard, no LF) and the inspection line G-15 cannot be fixed.

sheets_documents: S-2.10 / S-2.20 legend, S-1.10 schedule, A-2.10 wall note 1, A-2.20 wall note 1
subject: Typical stud size and the 2-hr wall type 1A
question: The S-2.10 / S-2.20 legend states '400S162-54 @ 16" typ. all walls', the S-1.10 schedule states '362S162-54 @ 16"' for the ground and second levels, A-2.10 wall note 1 prints 400S162-54 and A-2.20 wall note 1 prints '3-5/8" 20 GA' studs for the same wall tag: please confirm the stud size and gauge for wall types 1 and 2 and whether the 2-hr wall type 1A extends to the rated deck.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Interior walls: all new partitions (A-001..A-033 by tag, S-18, 527.7 LF of 16 GA studs on A-041) and the dumbwaiter shaft walls are priced on one of the sizes; the type 1A height fixes its 2-layer GWB area (A-035).

subject: Sloped mezzanine floor for exit-stair headroom
question: A-1.20 KN17 shows a 26 SF sloped mezzanine floor for the exit-stair headroom clearance with no structural detail on S-2.20 or the exit-stair S-sheets: please issue the construction of the sloped floor and state under which permit it is built.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Other required scope and Stairs & railing: line S-15 has no construction to price and the permit split (TI vs 26016-10000-18605) is open.

subject: Existing door access to the main building and untagged mezzanine wall
question: The exit-stair A-0.20 notes an '(E) door access to the main building (not code compliant)' to be removed without location, size or infill construction, and A-1.20 draws an untagged dashed double-line wall (14.4 LF) inside the exit-stair limit of work: please locate and size the door removal and infill, and state under which permit the untagged wall is removed.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Stairs & railing and Demolition: lines X-20 (door removal and infill) and D-24 (wall 14.4 LF) cannot be quantified or assigned to a permit.

sheets_documents: S-2.10, S-2.20, S-1.10 (raster only at 110 dpi), 4/S-3.10, A-9.10 headers
subject: Vector S-2.10 / S-2.20: shear-wall marks, holdowns, saddles, headers
question: The S-2.10 / S-2.20 sheets on hand are 110 dpi rasters on which the Sure-Board shear-wall marks (S-1.10 schedule marks 1-4) and S/HDU4 / S/HDU6 holdown symbols are not legible, the box-beam column-saddle count (4/S-3.10) and the attic joist extents cannot be confirmed, and the headers at new wall openings are 'see detail' with no count: please issue vector S-2.10 / S-2.20 (or legible prints) with the shear-wall and header schedule applied.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Other required scope: lines S-17 (Sure-Board shear walls and holdowns), S-16 (headers), S-12 (attic joist extents, 1,538 SF) and the saddle anchors for G-14 special inspection cannot be quantified.

subject: Hazardous-materials survey
question: No bid document requires or provides a hazardous-materials survey for the 1920s building (ceiling coffers, plaster, flooring mastics, pipe insulation to be demolished): please state whether a survey exists, its findings, and whether any abatement is in the bid.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Demolition and Other required scope: line G-28 (survey / abatement) has no scope and the coffer / plaster demolition (D-20) could become abatement work.

subject: Untagged dashed enclosure in the existing kitchen
question: A-1.10 draws an untagged dashed double-line enclosure 12.3 x 14.7 ft in the (E) kitchen next to the two KN4 walk-ins: please confirm whether it is a third walk-in box, an equipment enclosure or a partition to be removed.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Demolition: line D-02 (181 SF) is priced as a walk-in removal by assumption.

subject: Exit-stair steel finish and exit signage
question: The finish of the exit-stair steel (paint system or galvanizing) is not specified (stair 1 calls P-6) and the exit-sign symbols on the A-0.20 exit-analysis plans are legible for one location only: please specify the steel finish and the exit sign / egress signage count and circuit for the new exit stair.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Stairs & railing: lines X-23 (finish) and X-22 (exit signs) have no specification or count.

subject: Exit-stair storefront and door hardware
question: The fixed storefront panel between the two new exit doors (4'-8" wide, height taken from the (E) door) has no mullion layout or frame section, and the panic hardware and closer sets for the two storefront doors and the 1-hr exit-access door are not specified: please issue the storefront elevation / section and the hardware sets.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Stairs & railing: lines X-15, X-16 (framing LF) and X-17 (hardware) are priced on assumed products.

subject: Item 46 Rational combi oven (existing, relocated)
question: K2.0 item 46 'RATIONAL #I COMBI CLASSIC' (cell highlighted, size not given, plumbing columns blank) is existing relocated while K3.0 shows two +68 in rough-ins: please state the model / size and its water, drain and electrical requirements.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Owner-provided equipment install and Plumbing: the combi rough-in and filter (FE-45, P-058) and the 208 V 3 ph connection (E-015) cannot be fixed.

sheets_documents: K2.0 item 22, K3.0 note, cut sheet
subject: Item 22 grease interceptor connection size
question: K2.0 gives item 22 Big Dipper W-350-IS a 4 in waste while the cut sheet shows 3 in inlet / outlet and K3.0 notes 'VFY. W/ PLUMBER': please confirm the connection sizes and the 3 in drain / 2 in vent of P-3 GT-1.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Plumbing: line P-019 / P-025 (3 in run to GT-1) and the direct waste of KS-1 (P-065) are sized on P-3.

subject: Plan vs schedule quantity differences
question: K1.0 draws item 95 (slant rack shelf) twice (scullery and service bar) against a scheduled quantity of 1, item 2 lockers as one bank against qty 5, items 1 and 10 as 6 and 5 shelving units against '1 LOT', and single bubbles for items 26 / 36 / 89 scheduled 2 each: please confirm the quantities.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items F&B equipment and Owner-provided equipment install: lines FE-95, FE-2, FE-1, FE-10, FE-26, FE-36, FE-89 carry the schedule quantity.

sheets_documents: K1.0 (EXISTING STORAGE AREA), K2.0 items 1 and 2, A-2.10
subject: Existing storage area in the TI scope
question: K2.0 items 1 (storage shelving) and 2 (five existing lockers, relocated) sit in the 'EXISTING STORAGE AREA' on K1.0: please confirm whether that area is inside the tenant-improvement scope and whether its finishes are touched.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items F&B equipment and Owner-provided equipment install: lines FE-1 and FE-2 and any finish work in that room.

subject: Construction of existing elements to be demolished
question: The drawings do not state the construction, height or material of the (E) ramp (KN10), raised platform and steps (KN12), curved stair to the mezzanine (KN11), mezzanine ceiling coffers and mouldings (A-1.20 KN14, 890 SF), the 72 mezzanine ceiling light fixtures (KN15), the mezzanine walls KN13 / KN4 (heights) or the extent of terrazzo patching (A-1.10 KN14): please provide them or confirm they are to be verified at a pre-bid site walk.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Demolition: lines D-07..D-11, D-20..D-23 and D-26 are quantified by area or length only and cannot be priced by removal type.

sheets_documents: P-2, P-3, P-4, M-4 (vertical risers), M-6 (hanger rods)
subject: Floor-to-floor heights for risers and hangers
question: The vertical risers (basement to first floor, first floor to mezzanine, mezzanine to the second-floor roof) and the hood hanger-rod lengths are not dimensioned on any M- or P-sheet: please state the floor-to-floor and floor-to-roof heights at the riser locations.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Plumbing and Mechanical: lines P-030, P-050 (sanitary and water risers), P-061 (gas riser) and M-018 (hanger rods) are counted EA with no length.

sheets_documents: P-2 (first-floor restroom headers), P-4 (HW beyond the 1 in label)
subject: Unlabeled pipe sizes on P-2 / P-4
question: The re-piped (E) first-floor restroom CW / HW branch headers and fixture drops below the 2 in CW / 1 in HW labels on P-2 (41 LF) and the HW run to the mezzanine lavatories beyond the 1 in label on P-4 (27.5 LF) carry no sizes: please label them.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Plumbing: lines P-051 and P-055 (and their insulation in P-057) cannot be priced by size.

sheets_documents: A-2.10 / A-2.20 wall notes, A-9.10 detail 4, A-7.21
subject: Mold Tough GWB 'wet areas' and head-of-wall fire sealant
question: The wall notes call Mold Tough GWB to 4'-0" 'at wet areas' without defining the wet areas, and the rated walls (types 1, 1A, AC, UL U404) call only acoustical sealant at the ceiling line with no head-of-wall fire-stop system: please define the wet-area rooms and the head-of-wall fire sealant / fire-stop assembly for the rated walls.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Interior walls: lines A-046 (Mold Tough substitution 778 SF assumed) and A-045 (566 LF acoustical sealant) cannot be fixed; a rated head-of-wall system is not in any line.

subject: Perforated metal column enclosures 'TYP.'
question: Keynotes KN21 (A-2.10) and KN23 (A-2.20) call perforated metal column enclosures floor to exposed ceiling around the (E) plumbing lines 'TYP.' with one tag per plan: please state how many columns receive the enclosure and the perforation pattern, gauge and finish (see also RFI 036 on the enclosures to be removed).
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Interior finishes: line A-049 (4 EA assumed) has no count, product or finish to quote.

subject: Extents of furring, beam soffit, hallway-opening ceiling and the 24 in low wall
question: The extent of the KN15 furring and patching of the (E) wall (two locations), the A-4.30 beam-enclosure soffit length, the A-4.31 GWB ceiling above the hallway opening and the A-2.20 KN17 24 in low wall around the sloped stair ceiling are not dimensioned or drawn in plan: please dimension them.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Interior walls: lines A-048, A-050, A-051, A-052 carry no quantity.

sheets_documents: A-2.20 (layer Day2), A-7.10 doors 18 / 39, A-7.21 rooms 34 / 35
subject: Day-2 scope in the base bid
question: A-2.20 carries 27.4 LF of untyped walls on a 'Day2' layer, A-7.21 marks rooms 34 (BOH) and 35 (comedy club hallway) as Day2 with WC-4 finishes, and A-7.10 lists doors 18 and 39 (door 39 with a blank hardware set) in those rooms: please confirm whether the Day-2 walls, doors and finishes are in the base bid, an alternate, or excluded.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Interior walls, Doors & Hardware and Interior finishes: lines A-033, A-070, A-088, A-147, A-148 and the hallway-35 share of the B-5 LED base cannot be placed in the bid or excluded with certainty; more than one trade is affected.

sheets_documents: A-7.10 door and hardware schedule, door-type elevations, detail 7
subject: Door hardware gaps on A-7.10
question: On A-7.10 fourteen doors are marked self-closing but their hardware sets omit closer HW-4, the HW-5 pull and HW-6 pivot products print '-', the cylinder count on the E01 pair is not stated, exit door 16 carries a keyed lever (HW-9) instead of exit hardware, the 60-minute doors 19 / 34 / 35 / E38 are type G with ventilation louvers, the hinge finish prints '-' for every door, door 39 has no hardware set and the provided-by cells for HW-9 / HW-10 are blank: please complete the hardware schedule.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Doors & Hardware: lines A-089..A-103 and A-107 (hardware sets, hinges, louvers, thresholds) cannot be fixed; louvers in rated doors and a keyed lever on an exit door are code questions.

sheets_documents: A-7.10 window schedule (type A), A-7.20 GL-1, A-4.01 KN4, A-2.10
subject: Window A glass type and location
question: Window type A (3'-10" x 8'-1" fixed storefront unit) prints glass 'GL-1', which A-7.20 defines as the gold mirror for the 2nd-level bar, and its hexagon tag is not legible on A-2.10: please confirm the glass type for window A and that it is the fixed glass in the A-4.01 KN4 bay beside exit door 06.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Doors & Hardware and Exterior finishes: lines A-108 / A-203 (window A, Arcadia TC470 acoustic storefront) cannot be specified.

subject: CLG-1D framing, 8'-0" band edge and K-13 specification
question: The CLG-1D ceiling type gives no joist spacing or gauge, the edge of the 8'-0" dining band (A-3.12 KN3 'edge of attic') has no profile (a vertical GWB fascia 89.6 LF x 8'-9" is assumed), and the K-13 spray-applied insulation (AC-1) has no thickness, colour or NRC and no statement whether the coffer module is net or gross area: please issue them.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Ceilings: lines A-112..A-117 (3,050 SF CLG-1D, joists, fascia) and A-121 (3,773 SF K-13 gross) cannot be quoted to a product.

sheets_documents: A-5.11 ('no revision, reference only'), A-7.21, A-2.75, A-5.11 keynotes 13 / 15 / 16 / 21-23
subject: Existing restrooms 11 / 12 / 13: scheduled new finishes and accessories
question: A-5.11 marks the (E) restrooms 11, 12 and 13 'no revision, reference only' while A-7.21 schedules new FL-7 / FL-8 tile, B-1 base, WT-1 / WT-2 wall tile and a refinished CLG-1A ceiling there and A-5.11 carries new keynotes 13, 15, 16, 21-23 (accessories): please confirm whether the (E) restrooms receive the scheduled new finishes and accessories (see also RFI 033 for the plumbing retrofit).
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Flooring, Interior finishes and Plumbing: lines A-118 (417 SF ceiling), A-129 (371 SF of the 602 SF tile), A-135 (B-1 base), A-152 (510 SF wall tile) and A-193 (8 accessories) cannot be included or excluded; several trades are affected.

subject: Flooring products, grout, floor preparation and transitions
question: A-7.21 schedules FL-3 and B-3 at the mezzanine restrooms while A-7.20 marks both 'NOT USED' and A-2.76 shows FL-7 / FL-8 with GRT-1, the grout joint is 1/16 in on A-5.11 and 1/8 in on A-5.12 / A-7.20, the FL-9 terrazzo manufacturer is 'TBD', the WT-1 / WT-2 pattern split is not drawn, and no floor-preparation / moisture-testing or transition-strip profile is specified: please resolve the products and specify preparation and transitions.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Flooring: lines A-129, A-130, A-132, A-136, A-137 and A-151 cannot be quoted to a product or quantity.

sheets_documents: A-7.21 vs Addendum 1 A-4.26 / A-4.30-A-4.33, A-7.10 finish column
subject: Finish conflicts between A-7.21 and the Addendum 1 elevations
question: Hallway 04 is WC-3 on A-7.21 but WC-8 with poplar moulding on A-4.26, the mechanical attic 25 is WC-8 on all four walls, doors and frames are P-1 on A-7.10 but frames P-2 (1st floor) and P-5 / doors WC-4 (mezzanine) on the Addendum, and the ADA lift lobby walls are P-4 on A-7.21 but WC-4 on A-4.32: please state which governs.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Interior finishes: lines A-142 (1,104 SF), A-143 (1,788 SF), A-145 (moulding grid 3,939 LF), A-170 (door paint), A-157 / A-150 (lift lobby) carry the Addendum reading and may change.

sheets_documents: A-7.20 (WC-5, WC-6, WC-7, TX-1, TX-4, GL-1 and the unlisted codes LM-1/LM-2, ST-2/SL-2, STN-2, HW-20/21/22, P-6), Addendum 1 A-4.20-A-4.23
subject: Fabric panels, drapery, gold wallpaper / film / mirror and unlisted finish codes
question: A-7.20 leaves the WC-5 Tectum panel size, thickness and height (8'-0" vs 9'-1"), the TX-4 fabric product and fin panel sizes, the TX-1 location, the WC-6 / WC-7 products, the GL-1 mirror location and the drapery hardware HW-20 / HW-21, fullness and finished sizes open, and the Addendum / stair sheets use codes LM-1, LM-2, ST-2 / SL-2, STN-2, HW-22 and P-6 that have no A-7.20 entry: please complete the finish schedule.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Interior finishes: lines A-159, A-162..A-168, A-169 and A-180 cannot be quoted.

sheets_documents: A-2.20 KN22, Addendum 1 A-4.30 detail 5, A-2.10 KN18, A-2.75
subject: Stage platforms: size, height, LED base, fascia, steps
question: The mezzanine stage is 6 in AFF on A-2.20 KN22 but 10 in on A-4.30 detail 5 and has no outline for its three KN22 tags, and for both stages the LED base perimeter, the fascia finish and the steps or ramp to the 18 in main stage are not drawn: please issue stage plans and sections.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Interior finishes and Lighting: lines A-171 (64.5 SF main stage), A-172 (mezzanine stage, no area), A-173 and the stage share of the B-5 LED base (A-134) cannot be quantified.

sheets_documents: A-5.20, A-2.20 KN13, Addendum 1 A-4.33 details 2 and 8
subject: Pick-up counter and bar opening
question: The pick-up counter is 34 in AFF with a 36 in opening on A-5.20 / A-2.20 KN13 while the bar opening on A-4.33 is 6'-0" wide with a countertop at 42 in AFF, the countertop material is not stated and the KegWorks foot rail has no model: please state the governing height, width, countertop material and rail model.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Interior finishes: lines A-175 (stainless pick-up counter), A-176 (bar opening 6 LF), A-177 (foot rail) cannot be fabricated or quoted.

subject: Light-beam fins: count, profile and height datum
question: The A-4.22 elevation shows 9 light-beam fins while A-3.22 shows 8 'CURVE UP' zones, the fin side-face profile needed for the P-3 paint and TX-4 fabric areas is not dimensioned, and the 7'-9" / 8'-8" / 10'-4" fin heights on A-4.22 have no stated datum against the 15'-9" CLG-1D labels on A-3.22: please confirm the fin count, profile and datum.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Interior finishes, Ceilings and Lighting: lines A-174 (9 fins), A-122 (fin ceilings 168 SF), A-156 (P-3), A-165 (TX-4) and the 18 G5 strip lights (E-111, 17 ft each) depend on the fins.

sheets_documents: A-7.20 legend / action column, Addendum 1 A-4.20 / A-4.21
subject: Owner-furnished vs GC-furnished specialties
question: The A-7.20 action column reads 'GC' on every row and its legend shading for 'owner to provide, GC to install' cannot be told from the print: please state who furnishes the reception desk, the three mirrors, the hook rail, the make-up counter and the table lamp shown on A-4.20 / A-4.21.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Interior finishes and Owner-provided equipment install: lines A-181, A-184..A-188 may be owner-furnished.

subject: Fire extinguisher cabinets, signage and restroom accessory products
question: The 'FE' legend entry on A-2.10 / A-2.20 has no symbols placed on the plans, the green-room signage type is not stated, and the restroom accessories on A-5.12 (grab bars, dispensers, mirrors, hand dryers) have no manufacturer or model: please locate the FE cabinets and specify the signage and accessories.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Interior finishes: lines A-190, A-191, A-192 have no count or product.

subject: ADA lift model and pit size; dumbwaiter capacity and installer
question: A-6.22 specifies Garaventa Genesis Shaftway GVL-SW-120 while A-6.21 KN2 calls GVL-SW-144, the pit is 55-3/8 x 54-7/8 in (KN2) vs the 55-3/8 x 56-1/4 in shaftway of the specification, the McKinley 'elevator door' scope is not defined, and the Matot size K dumbwaiter is specified only as the 100-750 lb medium-duty class: please confirm the lift model and pit, the door scope, the dumbwaiter capacity and who installs each unit (see also RFIs 037, 038).
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Other required scope: lines A-200 (lift), A-201 (dumbwaiter), A-202 (pit access door) and the pit / shaft lines S-08, S-09, D-28 cannot be fixed.

sheets_documents: A-6.12 (P-6, LED riser strip), A-6.10 general note 7, A-7.20, A-3.70
subject: Stair 1: P-6 paint, warning strips and riser LED strip
question: A-6.12 calls paint P-6 on the stair-1 steel that is not listed on A-7.20, the visual warning strips on the carpeted treads have no product (painting is 'acceptable' per note 7), and the 'LED strip for riser illumination' on A-6.12 is not in the A-3.70 lighting schedule: please specify the three items.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Stairs & railing and Lighting: lines A-159 (63.7 LF P-6), A-195 (warning strips) and A-196 (60 LF riser LED) have no product.

subject: Hollywood Blvd exit-door bay: metal panel, plaster patch, terrazzo step, handrails, granite
question: On A-4.01 the extent of the aluminum metal panel at the door head (KN12), the plaster patching at the removed-window jambs and head, the thickness and edge of the FL-9 black terrazzo step and its coordination with the Hollywood Walk of Fame sidewalk, the material of the handrails 'to match (E)' (KN7) and the reuse location of the salvaged granite base (KN8) are not stated: please detail the bay.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter item Exterior finishes: lines A-204..A-210 and A-130 are quantified from the 7'-4" bay width only; the Walk of Fame work may need a separate agency approval.

subject: Stair 2 (1704 N Vine) finishes on Addendum 1 A-4.34
question: Addendum 1 A-4.34 shows finishes for stair 2 at 1704 N Vine (WC-4 wallpaper, B-4 base painted P-5, LED tread inserts, ADA railing P-5) that are not in the exit-stair permit set: please state whether these finishes are in the TI bid, the exit-stair permit, or excluded.
why_it_matters: Bid-letter items Stairs & railing and Interior finishes: the exit-stair package (X-01..X-23) carries no finishes beyond paint, and the G19 / G20 stair-2 strip lights (E-118, E-119) and B-5 LED base depend on the answer.
